materials.surface_notes: Keep shared opaque source colour, normal and ORM when supported. Start with 1K runtime maps and compare at mission camera. budgets.measurement_plan: Measure the prepared gun and base together and count unique decoded mip chains across both authored positions and one deployment. Record cold and cached construction and scene render cost.

acceptance_scenario: In the existing SGC Defense and SG3 Heavy gadget, validate deployment, mounting, aiming, firing and dismount, plus existing Airman interaction. Compare the cameras with the Sprint 11 baseline. Test four-player listen and dedicated while mounted and after retry, and package a clean release export.
